title: The Empty Throne
text: A throne stands in the Commons square this morning. Nobody built it. It is carved from something like black glass, it is warm, and it is exactly the right size for whoever looks at it. The city's poor have been bowing to it all morning. Each House may put a Scion in it, if they dare.

options.label: Sit a Scion on the black throne.

outcomes.text: Your Scion sits, and for one breath sees the whole city laid out like a map, and beyond it the Gate, and beyond the Gate a throne just like this one with somebody already in it. They stand up a little taller.
Your Scion sits, and something on the other side of the Gate sits down at the same moment, and looks at them. They scream until their voice goes.

options.label: Pay to have it chained and covered.

outcomes.text: It takes forty feet of iron chain and a great canvas sheet. Under the sheet, at night, something shifts its weight.

options.label: Walk the long way round the square.

outcomes.text: You walk round. The throne is facing your Seat the next morning.
